## Fixes

- **Walkability: you can block part of a cell that already uses both floor layers.**
  - **Before:** blocking with "This map only" adds an invisible blocker tile to a free floor layer. If a cell had no free floor layer, the stroke was skipped with "both floor layers are used, so there's no room for a blocker". The only option left was blocking the whole cell.
  - **Now:** the cell's own floor tile gets a copy with the flags added, the same way making a cell walkable already works. You can block any sub-tile of any cell, and take it off again.
  - Painting a whole cell still uses the map's whole-cell flag, which needs no tile.
- **Clearing part of a cell marked "unwalkable" now works even when both floor layers are used.** The rest of the cell stays blocked through the copied tile. Before, the whole stroke was skipped for that cell.
